prep_meta.notes: Only raw.ae is available (raw.aes and raw.ho are not in the provided raw datasets list and are skipped per instructions). Records are filtered to AESHOSP_STD=Yes (hospitalization seriousness criterion). HOREFID is the stringified RECORDID from raw.ae. HOTERM is assigned 'HOSPITAL' per the mapping rule. EPOCH is derived by joining sdtm.se and matching HOSTDTC within [SESTDTC, SEENDTC). HOSTDY/HOENDY require date arithmetic against RFSTDTC from sdtm.dm — the engine must implement actual ISO date subtraction. HODCGDSP and HOENTPT have no raw source in this study and will be null. HOSEQ must be assigned as a sequential integer within USUBJID after sorting by USUBJID and HOSTDTC in the final build step (the derive step above is a placeholder — the engine should implement row-number-within-subject logic).
